entries.definition: A character, mascot, or brand may require a stronger model or human confirmation.
The animation contains multiple meaningful phases or a hard-to-summarize cycle.
Semantic facets contain a rule conflict that the primary result did not resolve.
The visible object is small, low-contrast, or otherwise hard to inspect.
The semantic transcription conflicts with an independent OCR verifier signal.
Some visible text is only partially recognized.
The item belongs to the deterministic quality-control sample for this run.
The primary model exhausted the allowed schema repair attempt.
Potential sensitive content requires stronger analysis or human review.
The accepted model result has no exact active qualification for its generation tuple.
